content: Which apostle wrote the letter of 1 Peter?
explanation: He wrote to scattered believers. “Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ” (1 Peter 1:1, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, why should we cast all our anxiety on God?
explanation: God loves His children. “Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.” (1 Peter 5:7, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, the devil prowls around like what?
explanation: Be alert. “Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.” (1 Peter 5:8, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, what covers over a multitude of sins?
explanation: Love one another deeply. “because love covers over a multitude of sins.” (1 Peter 4:8, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, believers should crave spiritual milk like what?
explanation: So they grow in salvation. “Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk” (1 Peter 2:2, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, what should you always be ready to explain to anyone who asks?
explanation: Answer with gentleness and respect. “Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you.” (1 Peter 3:15, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, believers are called a chosen people and a royal what?
explanation: Called out of darkness into light. “But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation” (1 Peter 2:9, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, God has given us new birth into a living what?
explanation: Through Jesus' resurrection. “He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead” (1 Peter 1:3, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, while grass withers, what stands forever?
explanation: Peter quotes Isaiah. “but the word of the Lord stands forever.” (1 Peter 1:25, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, where did Christ bear our sins in His body?
explanation: So we might live to righteousness. “He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree” (1 Peter 2:24, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, believers have returned to the Shepherd and what of their souls?
explanation: They had been like straying sheep. “but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.” (1 Peter 2:25, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, how many people were saved in Noah's ark?
explanation: They were saved through water. “In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.” (1 Peter 3:20, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, through whom did Peter write the letter?
explanation: Peter called him a faithful brother. “Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly” (1 Peter 5:12, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, whom does Peter call “my son”?
explanation: Mark sent greetings too. “as does my son Mark.” (1 Peter 5:13, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, the church in which city sends greetings?
explanation: It was chosen together with them. “The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings” (1 Peter 5:13, BSB)

content: In 1 Peter, which of these regions is named among the readers' homes?
explanation: They were exiles of the Dispersion. “throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia” (1 Peter 1:1, BSB)
